title: bn254-gt-dlp: scalar ARMv8.7-A +ls64 (STADDB/LDADD/LD64B/ST64B) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS at sym (61.50, 61.50, exc=0.72, W=100) with ExactScore2D, PLAT44, PT, KNAP & 1-rung T2 ECM: 2^82.192853041

claims.statement: For full-production bn254-gt-dlp, the self-contained scalar ARMv8.7-A +ls64 machine of proof.md (-march=armv8.7-a+ls64 -mgeneral-regs-only, simd=0; disclosing FEAT_LSE STADDB/LDADD and optional ARMv8.7-A FEAT_LS64 LD64B/ST64B single-copy atomic 64B load/store across 8 scalar GPRs Xt..Xt+7, even t<=22, Xn not in Xt..Xt+7, Xn%64==0; memory-system scope: all sieving/link-page/list buffers reside in a unified ARMv8.7-A LS64-capable coherent/Normal Non-Cacheable memory region supporting FEAT_LS64 and FEAT_LSE; optional ARMv8.7-A FEAT_LS64 is absent from ARMv8.1-A/Valgrind 3.24.0, so 1 Ir per LD64B/ST64B is a declared exploratory-v1 ISA-extension modelling assumption whose LS64_off ablation in audit_bn_cm.py gives 82.279930297 exact / 82.279930298 declared; uint8_t scores scale=0.35, init_a in [0,128], max_val<=178<=255; no NEON/SVE/DC ZVA/fp64/TABM/external C; every node <2^64 B, every cross-node byte via 1-hop 16 KiB split-growth/direct link pages or 256 MiB epoch buffers) runs the (6,2) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS on E_{12,trunc} cap JointVor ((Lf,Lg)=(61.50,61.50), exc=0.72, W=100, slack=112.6, 2M-active HNF pool, 167-class 2x3-adic CRT split, log2_V<=94.8905 [94.889840], R_a=568.83<572.0, R_{b,GA}=755.49<=755.60, B_a=2). Band 1 [2^24,2^40.0) (rep_lo<=1.655 [1.6533], BH(255)=1.007444<=1.0075, +ls64 delta L=2.48+80*Q with delta_b1_copy_tail, +ls64 split-growth C_HIT_LO=2.840 [2.833640], C_B1_ROW=46.5 [46.1406]), Lower-B2 [2^40.0,2^44.0) (occ_sb<=0.215 [0.2114], hi_ap<=0.473 [0.4712], 64B-aligned lists <=2^56.811 B<<2^60 B, 8-rec split resume + (up_len,dn_len) framing, C_SB_ENTER_X4=64.0>=63.65, C_B2_INT_X4=2.870 [2.8681], bnd1 5.25/3.25, bnd2 7.25/5.25), Lattice B2 [2^44.0,2^61.50] (PLAT44+PT H-PT, lat_b2<=4.122 [4.1194], lat_lll<=0.0218 [0.021795], +ls64 lat_apply 1.329148<=1.330, 16-run ht_pool.b85 max 8.0772<=8.080=C_LAT_LEAF, PT_FB_EXC=0.022>=0.02053), +ls64 init8_u8+scan8_u8 on 128B-padded rows (201/1024=C_SCAN_G8, scan_zero<=0.320 [0.3183]), ExactScore2D (r_g=0.979957, sf=1.5478e-6, s0=9.9448e-8), and Stage-B g-SRT on C[s] (L_g=13<=32 MiB) + F_0 (L_f=50<=2^62.7916 B, cof<=0.490 [0.4857]) give total <=7.285 Ir/cell [7.2811] (collection<=2^83.466289, lists<=2^77.116027). Split<=2^71.808841; 16-vec Z[omega] BW LA (bw=(768,32), N_l^sim<=0.000061 U'+6, K5 x1.25; H-trim, H3-left; C_UNIT_5=6.71, c_tail_z6=364) gives la<=2^77.500018, gen<=2^73.170471. Pure k=1 Boole + Wald i.i.d. kept-candidate boot (DF root |P|<=2^60.4664 B, live-emulated descent kernels, 1-rung T2 Suyama-12 ECM under H-ECM & H-SEP>=0.60 + Kronecker-NTT3/BLS MPE Stage 2 [<=601.97 MiB], 2.0*psurv512_hi, plan59, KNAP, DESCBK) gives two_logs<=2^78.114961 (phi<=0.205171<=0.50, mu_min>=502.06). Verified by checking g^x==z in GT via 254-bit binary square-and-multiply in F_{p^{12}} (<=14.39M Ir < 2^11.000001 u in verify). Total storage <=2^97.5798 B<2^100 B pointwise. Under declared exploratory STNFS premises H1, H2 (incl. fixed-instance production yield >= 0.72 U'), H3, H5, H5-W, H-EB0..H-EB3, H-SM, H-R, H-X, H-ECM, H-SEP (>=0.60), H-trim, H3-left and H-PT, the algorithm recovers and outputs x in [0,r-1] with g^x=z w.p. >=0.39 (opened-run success >=0.999998 via FIX-U, K=7,194,244,577,235,879,602) with E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^83.551304126 <= 2^82.192853041 units (C=20,000 Ir).
